images.alt: Complementary access changes answerability. The exact original-port obstruction persists under either single-sided addition. Joint access exposes a difference in hidden adjacency.
Robust output bands for the constructed experiment. The alternatives have independently uncertain parameters; the selected time maximizes their certified separation on the declared grid.
The successor portfolio separates six model hypotheses while tolerating one terminal-access outage. Colored cells show the modeled adjacency class observed by each selected experiment.

Complete-project economic scenarios. All amounts are simulated USD and include the stated construction, selling, delivery, support, financing and exit costs. Sampling uncertainty does not measure confidence in the demand assumptions.
